skill: Describing an incident and your feelings

words.def: to clearly bring attention to a worry or problem so it can be dealt with
words.ex: It's important to {raise your concerns} about poor service.

words.def: making you annoyed because things are not going the way you want
words.ex: It was {frustrating} to wait an hour for a cold meal.

words.def: something given in place of what you originally wanted
words.ex: They sent a {substitute} dish because my first choice was sold out.

words.def: happening quickly, at the right time
words.ex: The delivery was {prompt}: it arrived in under twenty minutes.

words.def: to find a solution to a problem
words.ex: The manager promised to {resolve} the issue with our missing order straight away.

words.def: sad because something was not as good as you hoped
words.ex: I was {disappointed} when the restaurant got my order wrong.

words.def: to say approximately how long something will take or cost
words.ex: The app {estimated} a thirty-minute wait, but it took over an hour.

words.def: to formally tell a company that something went wrong
words.ex: I had to {make a complaint} because three items were missing.
